annotations.title: Get what the wallet must sign

description: Returns what the sender's wallet has to sign for a quote from quote_send or quote_swap. kind "evm-typed-data": sign every steps[].typedData with eth_signTypedData_v4, in order (one authorization, or for permit tokens a permit plus the order itself); binding is the order the authorization commits to, so recipient, fee and minimum can be checked first. kind "tron-transactions": sign every steps[].transaction (first the fee, then the transfer). kind "evm-transactions" (gas drop, BNB Chain): if funding.needed, sign funding.message with personal_sign (a message, no transaction, proves the wallet is the sender's) and call submit_signatures with fund: true and that fundSignature first, so gasrescue sends the wallet the gas; then send every steps[].tx from the wallet (eth_sendTransaction, fee first) and report the hashes with submit_signatures txs: { fee, transfer }. kind "solana-transaction" or "solana-versioned-transaction": sign the base64 transaction. Read-only. Pass the result to submit_signatures. Fails when the quote expired; then request a new quote.

transferId.description: The id gasrescue returned as transfer.id from quote_send or quote_swap: 24 lowercase hex characters, e.g. "b39f46001a5680455091152d". Not a transaction hash and not an id of another service.
